note: The selector IDs are adapter identities; the current Rust resolver accepts opencode/pi/runner/mcp:/fed: and has no distinct OpenCode generation or OMP enum. OMP uses the Pi extension with API-based detection. Do not forward selector strings opencode-v1/opencode-v2/omp to Harness::from_str unchanged.

project_boundary.pi_omp: Pi extension initializes at process.cwd() and passes that directory to loadAftConfig; no ancestor traversal in readConfigTiers.
project_boundary.opencode: registration root is worktree when present and not filesystem-root sentinel, otherwise directory; project config at that root/.cortexkit/aft.jsonc; no ancestor traversal in readConfigTiers.
project_boundary.standalone_cli: cwd supplies project discovery origin; do not use diagnostic adapter config path as project root.

fix_scope: Ordinary tier loader consumes only the two shared CortexKit paths. Legacy sources are read by one-time location migration if target absent, not additional active tiers. Inactive/unconsumed legacy files are not doctor --fix targets; name them in release notes. All embedded harness blocks in an eligible shared file are in scope.
